title: Yui Home Assisstant
README: A voice → text app using [Gradio](https://gradio.app) and a local [Whisper](https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-small) model for speech recognition. Records or uploads audio and transcribes it — runs fully locally, no API token required.
APP_FILE:
from functools import lru_cache
from transformers import pipeline

from functools import lru_cache

import gradio as gr
from transformers import pipeline

# Whisper speech -> text. Pick a size in the dropdown (label -> model id).
WHISPER_MODELS = {
    "small (244M, fast)": "openai/whisper-small",
    "medium (769M)": "openai/whisper-medium",
    "large-v3-turbo (809M)": "openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo",
}
DEFAULT_MODEL = "small (244M, fast)"


@lru_cache(maxsize=len(WHISPER_MODELS))
def get_asr(model_id):
    """Lazy-load (and cache) a Whisper pipeline per model id."""
    return pipeline("automatic-speech-recognition", model=model_id)


def transcribe(audio_path, model_label):
    if not audio_path:
        return ""
    return get_asr(WHISPER_MODELS[model_label])(audio_path)["text"].strip()


with gr.Blocks() as demo:
    gr.Markdown("# 🎤 Voice → Text\nRecord or upload audio to transcribe.")
    model = gr.Dropdown(
        choices=list(WHISPER_MODELS.keys()),
        value=DEFAULT_MODEL,
        label="Whisper model",
        info="First use of each model downloads it (medium/turbo are larger).",
    )
    audio = gr.Audio(sources=["microphone", "upload"], type="filepath", label="Audio")
    text = gr.Textbox(label="Transcription", lines=4)

    # Auto-transcribe when a recording stops; the button covers uploaded files.
    audio.stop_recording(transcribe, inputs=[audio, model], outputs=text)
    gr.Button("Transcribe", variant="primary").click(
        transcribe, inputs=[audio, model], outputs=text
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    demo.launch()
